name: Palacký University Olomouc
summary: Founded in 1573 in Olomouc; seven English-taught degrees in five faculties, from English and petroleum engineering to medicine and dentistry.

ib.text: UP's guide for foreign applicants treats the IB Diploma as a Czech school-leaving certificate: send a certified copy, with no recognition fee. Each faculty runs its own selection.

programmes.name: Czech for Foreigners
programmes.about: Czech language, literature, history and culture taught through English, aiming at B2 Czech, with English skills built up for international careers. It cannot be combined with another programme.
programmes.ib: Needs a year of university Czech abroad or an intensive Czech course first, then a Czech exam at A1 (written and oral); English A2.
programmes.selectionNote: Czech exam at A1, written and oral, plus a motivation letter and a teacher's recommendation. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: English Philology
programmes.about: English linguistics, British and American literature and cultural studies, with optional courses that let you specialise in linguistics, literature or translation. Leads on to the English Philology master's.
programmes.ib: Admission on your documents: school certificate, motivation letter, CV and an English certificate at B2.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on the papers you send: school certificate, motivation letter, CV and B2 English. 10 places. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: English Language for Education
programmes.about: English linguistics, literature including children's literature, and the culture of English-speaking countries, with the theory of teaching English, preparing teaching assistants for pupils aged 5 to 15.
programmes.ib: English at B2 with a certificate (IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 70), a 9,000-character motivation essay, a CV and an online interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Your motivation essay and CV, then an online interview on your motivation and readiness to study English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Petroleum Engineering
programmes.about: Petroleum geoscience and engineering: oil and gas exploration and production, reservoir modelling, drilling, gas storage and geothermal energy, with field, lab and computing work, taught in Olomouc.
programmes.ib: Written entrance exams in chemistry and mathematics; English at B2, or proof of earlier study in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Written exams in chemistry and mathematics; there were two application rounds. 40 places. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.about: A four-year physiotherapy degree with clinical practice from the second year: anatomy, kinesiology, rehabilitation methods and assessment, practised on each other and then on patients.
programmes.ib: Online entrance test in human biology and natural science plus an interview; English B1, waived if your schooling was in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Online multiple-choice test in human biology and natural science, then an online interview. One attempt a year; 12–18 students admitted for 2027/28.
programmes.closesNote: Apply two weeks before your chosen exam date

programmes.name: General Medicine
programmes.about: The same six-year medical curriculum Czech students follow, taught in English: sciences first, preclinical subjects, then clinical rotations, with Czech lessons in the first three years for talking to patients.
programmes.ib: Entrance test in biology, chemistry and physics or maths; English test unless your schooling was in English. No grade minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: One written test, online or in Olomouc, once a year. EU citizens can also sit the late-August dates. About 80 places. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: two weeks before your exam; by 31 July

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: Five years from the basic sciences through medical subjects to preventive, restorative and surgical dentistry, orthodontics and prosthodontics, with four periods of practice in a dentist's surgery.
programmes.ib: Entrance test in biology, chemistry and physics or maths; English test unless your schooling was in English. No grade minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: The same written test as medicine, online or in Olomouc, once a year. EU citizens can also sit the late-August dates. About 20 places. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: two weeks before your exam; by 31 July

notes: Medicine and Dentistry: EU citizens can also take the late-August exam dates that other applicants cannot, but you get one attempt a year.
Medicine, Dentistry and Physiotherapy close applications two weeks before the exam date you pick, so choose the date first.
Some faculty pages still ask for nostrification; UP's foreign-applicant guide says an IB Diploma needs none, so send a certified copy.
